queries: WITH g AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), s AS (SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), b AS (SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline FROM s) SELECT ordertypedist, cnt AS distinct_transactions, share, share - baseline AS above_baseline FROM b WHERE share > baseline ORDER BY share DESC

WITH linked AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS txn_count FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), shares AS (SELECT ordertypedist, txn_count, txn_count * 1.0 / SUM(txn_count) OVER () AS share FROM linked), baseline AS (SELECT s.*, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares s) SELECT ordertypedist, txn_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_baseline FROM baseline WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC

assumptions.assumption: Share is expressed as a fraction (0-1), not a percentage, and the excess over baseline is in the same fraction units.
Records with a NULL ordertypedist form their own group, shown with a NULL mix value, and count as one of the mixes in the baseline average.
The total across mixes is the sum of the per-mix distinct transaction counts. Each transaction has exactly one mix, so this equals the overall distinct transaction count.

responses.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS txn_count FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), shares AS (SELECT ordertypedist, txn_count, txn_count * 1.0 / SUM(txn_count) OVER () AS share FROM linked), baseline AS (SELECT s.*, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares s) SELECT ordertypedist, txn_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_baseline FROM baseline WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC

assumptions.assumption: The total across all mixes is the sum of the per-mix distinct transaction counts. Each transaction has one ordertypedist, so this equals the number of distinct linked transactions. Shares therefore sum to 1.
Records with a NULL ordertypedist form their own group, which is included in the total and in the baseline average, and can be returned if its share is above the baseline.
The baseline is the unweighted average of the per-mix shares. It equals 1 divided by the number of mixes, including the NULL group.
The gap is the share minus the baseline, shown as a fraction (not a percentage) and unrounded.

responses.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), shares AS (SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM linked), base AS (SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline FROM shares) SELECT ordertypedist, cnt AS transaction_count, share, share - baseline AS excess_over_baseline FROM base WHERE share > baseline ORDER BY share DESC

assumptions.assumption: Records with NULL ordertypedist form their own group (GROUP BY keeps NULLs as one group), and this group counts as a mix in the total and in the baseline average.

The total across all mixes is the sum of per-mix distinct transaction counts. Since transreg is the primary key, each transaction has one mix, so this equals the number of distinct linked transactions.

The baseline is the unweighted mean of the per-mix shares, which equals 1 divided by the number of mixes. The 'how far above' figure is share minus baseline, as an absolute difference in share and not a relative ratio.
